panels.description: Whether any Keeper replica reports itself as leader. A Raft leader steps down when it loses contact with a majority of the cluster, so a present leader indicates quorum.
panels.title: Quorum

panels.description:
Compares the leader plus its synced followers (ClickHouseAsyncMetrics_KeeperSyncedFollowers) against a majority of the cluster size reported by the leader (ClickHouseAsyncMetrics_KeeperFollowers + 1).

Keeper can have quorum but still not be operational. For example when the only follower is so far behind that the leader can't accept any new writes (because it is waiting for the follower to commit).

targets.expr:
clamp(
(
    max(ClickHouseAsyncMetrics_KeeperSyncedFollowers{namespace="$namespace", app="c-$service_name-keeper"})
    +
    max(ClickHouseAsyncMetrics_KeeperIsLeader{namespace="$namespace", app="c-$service_name-keeper"})
)
-
ceil((max(ClickHouseAsyncMetrics_KeeperFollowers{namespace="$namespace", app="c-$service_name-keeper"}) + 1) / 2),
-1, 0)
or vector(-1)

panels.title: Operational (Quorum and enough synced followers)

targets.expr: floor(avg by (pod) (ClickHouseAsyncMetrics_KeeperIsLeader{namespace="$namespace", app="c-$service_name-keeper"})) - floor(avg by (pod) (ClickHouseAsyncMetrics_KeeperIsFollower{namespace="$namespace", app="c-$service_name-keeper"}))

panels.description: Entries appended to uncommitted memtables, by action. Every write to the storage lands here first.
panels.title: Entries Appended

panels.description: Serialized bytes appended to memtables. 'uncommitted' is the sum over create/update/remove entries; 'committed' is what reaches the committed memtable (and is later flushed to disk).
panels.title: Entry Bytes Appended

panels.description: Average serialized size of an entry appended to uncommitted memtables, by action (bytes / count).
panels.title: Average Entry Size

panels.description: New memtables started. A committed memtable is finalized (and queued for flush) once it exceeds committed_memtable_size; an uncommitted one once it exceeds uncommitted_memtable_size.
panels.title: Memtables Created

panels.description: Successfully finished memtable flushes and merges of sorted runs.
panels.title: Flushes and Merges

panels.description: Writes delayed because flushes or merges fell behind, and failures in background work. All of these should normally be zero.
panels.title: Throttled Writes and Background Exceptions

panels.description: Compressed bytes written to sorted files by memtable flushes, i.e. new data entering the on-disk LSMT. Multiply by write amplification to get total disk writes.
panels.title: Flush Output (compressed)

panels.description: Uncompressed / compressed bytes of files written by flushes and merges.
panels.title: Compression Ratio

panels.description: (flush output + merge output) / flush output, in compressed bytes. How many times each byte that enters the LSMT is written to disk over its life, including rewrites by merges.
panels.title: Write Amplification

panels.description: Uncompressed bytes written by merges divided by uncompressed bytes of input files consumed. Lower means merges are dropping more obsolete entries (updates and tombstones).
panels.title: Merge Output / Input Ratio

panels.description: Total node lookups: hits in uncommitted memtables plus all getCommittedNode calls (found in memory, nonexistent, or loaded block from disk). KeeperLSMTGetUncommittedNodeMisses is not counted as it falls through to a committed lookup.

targets.expr: (avg by (pod) (rate(ClickHouseProfileEvents_KeeperLSMTGetUncommittedNodeHits{namespace="$namespace", app="c-$service_name-keeper"}[$__rate_interval])) + avg by (pod) (rate(ClickHouseProfileEvents_KeeperLSMTGetCommittedNodeFromMemory{namespace="$namespace", app="c-$service_name-keeper"}[$__rate_interval])) + avg by (pod) (rate(ClickHouseProfileEvents_KeeperLSMTGetCommittedNodeNonexistent{namespace="$namespace", app="c-$service_name-keeper"}[$__rate_interval])) + avg by (pod) (rate(ClickHouseProfileEvents_KeeperLSMTGetCommittedNodeLoadedBlock{namespace="$namespace", app="c-$service_name-keeper"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Node Lookups

panels.description: Node cache entries re-pointed at freshly loaded blocks, per committed node lookup (KeeperLSMTNodeCacheEntriesUpdated / all getCommittedNode calls). Roughly the share of looked-up nodes whose block was not in memory, normalized so that one block load counts once per node it brings back.

targets.expr: avg by (pod) (rate(ClickHouseProfileEvents_KeeperLSMTNodeCacheEntriesUpdated{namespace="$namespace", app="c-$service_name-keeper"}[$__rate_interval])) / (avg by (pod) (rate(ClickHouseProfileEvents_KeeperLSMTGetCommittedNodeFromMemory{namespace="$namespace", app="c-$service_name-keeper"}[$__rate_interval])) + avg by (pod) (rate(ClickHouseProfileEvents_KeeperLSMTGetCommittedNodeNonexistent{namespace="$namespace", app="c-$service_name-keeper"}[$__rate_interval])) + avg by (pod) (rate(ClickHouseProfileEvents_KeeperLSMTGetCommittedNodeLoadedBlock{namespace="$namespace", app="c-$service_name-keeper"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Node Adjusted Miss Rate

panels.description: When a node lookup has to load an evicted block from disk, all node cache entries for nodes in that block are re-pointed at the fresh copy. This is the average number of entries updated per such load; low values mean each disk read benefits few nodes.
panels.title: Node Cache Entries Re-pointed per Block Load

panels.description: Share of block accesses in sorted files that had to load a block group from disk: loaded groups / (weak pointer hits + block cache hits + loaded groups).

targets.expr: avg by (pod) (rate(ClickHouseProfileEvents_KeeperLSMTGetBlockLoadedGroup{namespace="$namespace", app="c-$service_name-keeper"}[$__rate_interval])) / (avg by (pod) (rate(ClickHouseProfileEvents_KeeperLSMTGetBlockFromWeakPtr{namespace="$namespace", app="c-$service_name-keeper"}[$__rate_interval])) + avg by (pod) (rate(ClickHouseProfileEvents_KeeperLSMTGetBlockFromCache{namespace="$namespace", app="c-$service_name-keeper"}[$__rate_interval])) + avg by (pod) (rate(ClickHouseProfileEvents_KeeperLSMTGetBlockLoadedGroup{namespace="$namespace", app="c-$service_name-keeper"}[$__rate_interval])))
